images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial illustration of the unreconstructed coastal archaeological site Ahu Hanga Poukura on the southern coast of Rapa Nui, Chile. Long low weathered volcanic stone ceremonial platform amid short green grass, toppled and eroded moai lying horizontally among dark volcanic stones, a few scattered weathered red scoria pukao, rugged Pacific shoreline and deep blue ocean in background, bright soft late afternoon natural light and sweeping low horizon. Respect archaeological reality: NO upright moai, no restored row of statues, no intact temple, no invented giant heads embedded upright. Ground-level wide composition, restrained realistic colors, textured stone, quiet open space in left quarter for website text, no people, no text, no logos, no montage.
